big-halogen._comment: Halogen Flash 0.20.6 (closed binary, EULA: no telemetry, no outbound connections without HALOGEN_DOWNLOAD) serving Qwen3.8-Flash-Next = big's model, for the comparison in plans/halogen-timeline.md. Device and memory settings from its Quickstart (Docker form). Sampling and thinking effort set to big's so the test is fair. Long stop timeout: an unclean exit can hold GPU memory until a reboot (its issues #79, #34).
